description: [shici] Get one random famous line of classical Chinese poetry (诗/词/曲), optionally from a theme. Use it for a daily quote, a greeting card line or a writing prompt. Returns content (the line), origin (poem title), author and category (theme path such as 古诗文-抒情-感恩).

theme.description: Theme: all (default), or a category path such as shuqing (抒情), siji (四季), shanshui (山水), tianqi (天气), renwu (人物), shenghuo (生活), jieri (节日), dongwu (动物), zhiwu (植物)

name: shici_random
title: Chinese classical poetry: random
